library.title: Document library
library.description: Published policies, procedures, manuals and other controlled documents you are cleared to see.
library.search: Search title, number, description and file text
library.emptyHint: Change the filters, or submit a new document for review.

ask.title: Ask the documents
ask.hint: Ask a question; the answer only uses published documents you may see.
ask.placeholder: For example: how many days of annual leave can be carried over?

document.downloadHint: The copy carries an "uncontrolled when printed" stamp.
document.confirmTitle: Confirm the document is still valid
document.confirmDescription: The expiry date moves forward by the type's validity period. The confirmation is logged.
document.expiryDescription: Leave the date empty for a document valid until superseded. The change is audited.
document.conflict: Someone else changed this document. It has been reloaded; try again.
document.withdrawnBanner: This document was withdrawn and is kept as an archive.
document.inReview: This document is still in review. Follow it on its request.

validity.expiredHint: Confirm it is still valid, submit a new version or request its withdrawal.
validity.noEvents: No reminders, confirmations or expiry changes yet.

versions.label: Version
versions.compareHint: Select two versions to compare them.

compare.title: Compare versions
compare.same: The two versions have the same text.
compare.notEnough: This document has only one version you may see.
compare.noText: No text could be read from these versions.

dashboard.title: Document dashboard
dashboard.description: Published, expired and expiring documents, review backlog and recent publications.

settings.title: Document Registry
settings.description: Document types, sensitivity clearance, validity reminders and the download watermark.
settings.organisationCodeHint: Value of {ORG} in the Document ID (letters and digits, up to 10).
settings.typesHint: Numbering code, validity and defaults for each document type.
settings.sensitivitiesHint: Who may read published documents of each sensitivity level.
settings.remindersHint: Days before expiry when the owner is reminded (up to 5).
settings.watermarkHint: The stored file is never changed; each download carries the stamp.
settings.publicLinks: Allow public links for public documents
settings.conflict: Someone else saved these settings. They have been reloaded; make your changes again.

errors.code: Use letters and digits only (up to 10).
errors.duplicate: Each type and sensitivity may appear only once.
errors.reminderDays: Up to 5 reminders, each between 1 and 365 days.
errors.notRevisable: Only a published or expired document you own can get a new version.
errors.versionInProgress: A new version of this document is already in progress.
errors.shareNotAllowed: Documents of this sensitivity cannot be shared with all employees.
errors.expiryBeforeEffective: The expiry date must be after the effective date.
errors.finalPdf: Upload the signed final document as a PDF.
errors.notWithdrawable: Only a published or expired document you own can be withdrawn.
errors.noExpiry: This document is valid until superseded and has no expiry to confirm.
errors.ackNotRequired: This document does not need an acknowledgement, or you already acknowledged it.
errors.noText: No text could be read from this document.

myWork.expiring: Document you own is expiring soon
